findings.source_passage: it may as well be related that I, for one, had no idea of so doing. For my mind was made up to sail in no other than a Nantucket craft
findings.why_it_matters: The self-conscious narratorial aside ('it may as well be related that I, for one') is a voice-establishing gesture of Ishmael's ironic self-presentation; stripping it removes the narrator's characteristic mock-formality.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'it may as well be related that I, for one, had no idea of so doing' before the Nantucket-craft declaration.

findings.source_passage: a very dubious-looking, nay, a very dark and dismal night, bitingly cold and cheerless
findings.why_it_matters: The rhetorical self-correction ('dubious-looking, nay, a very dark') is a signature Ishmael move—hesitation-then-amplification—that the draft flattens to plain 'a very dark and dismal night.'
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'a very dubious-looking, nay, a very dark and dismal night' to preserve the narrator's characteristic self-correcting rhetoric.

findings.source_passage: It was a negro church; and the preacher's text was about the blackness of darkness
findings.why_it_matters: The draft changes 'was about the blackness of darkness' to 'was of the blackness of darkness'—a minor verbal shift, but 'about' is the source reading and the phrasing is thematically charged.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'was about the blackness of darkness' verbatim.

findings.source_passage: and heard a forlorn creaking in the air; and looking up, saw a swinging sign over the door
findings.source_locator: paragraph 7, approach to the Spouter Inn
findings.why_it_matters: The draft drops 'heard a forlorn creaking in the air'—a sensory, atmospherically distinctive detail that introduces the Spouter Inn aurally before visually, characteristic of Melville's layered scene-setting.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'heard a forlorn creaking in the air' before 'looking up, saw a swinging sign.'

summary: The draft is largely faithful and preserves all high-priority signature passages verbatim, including the Nantucket-as-Tyre-of-Carthage passage, the Ishmael self-address, the Euroclydon digression, and the Dives/Lazarus meditation; four minor voice-flattening instances noted but none rise to high severity.
